import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/coffee_sales.csv')

# Convert date to datetime
df['date'] = pd.to_datetime(df['date'])

# Create a figure with multiple subplots for comprehensive visualization
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(14, 10))
fig.suptitle('Coffee Shop Sales Analysis Dashboard', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=1.02)

# Define a color palette
colors = sns.color_palette("husl", 8)

# 1. Top-left: Sales by Product
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
product_sales = df.groupby('product')['total'].sum().sort_values(ascending=True)
bars1 = ax1.barh(product_sales.index, product_sales.values, color=colors[:len(product_sales)])
ax1.set_xlabel('Total Sales ($)', fontsize=10)
ax1.set_ylabel('Product', fontsize=10)
ax1.set_title('Total Sales by Product', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
# Add value labels
for bar, val in zip(bars1, product_sales.values):
    ax1.text(val + 50, bar.get_y() + bar.get_height()/2, f'${val:,.0f}', 
             va='center', fontsize=9)

# 2. Top-right: Sales by Customer Age Group
ax2 = axes[0, 1]
age_order = ['18-24', '25-34', '35-44', '45-54', '55+']
age_sales = df.groupby('customer_age_group')['total'].sum().reindex(age_order)
bars2 = ax2.bar(age_sales.index, age_sales.values, color=sns.color_palette("viridis", len(age_sales)))
ax2.set_xlabel('Customer Age Group', fontsize=10)
ax2.set_ylabel('Total Sales ($)', fontsize=10)
ax2.set_title('Total Sales by Customer Age Group', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax2.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=0)
# Add value labels
for bar in bars2:
    height = bar.get_height()
    ax2.text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width()/2., height + 100, f'${height:,.0f}',
             ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=9)

# 3. Bottom-left: Payment Method Distribution with Takeaway breakdown
ax3 = axes[1, 0]
payment_takeaway = df.groupby(['payment_method', 'is_takeaway'])['total'].sum().unstack(fill_value=0)
payment_takeaway.columns = ['Dine-in', 'Takeaway']
payment_takeaway.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax3, color=['#3498db', '#e74c3c'], width=0.7)
ax3.set_xlabel('Payment Method', fontsize=10)
ax3.set_ylabel('Total Sales ($)', fontsize=10)
ax3.set_title('Sales by Payment Method & Order Type', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax3.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=0)
ax3.legend(title='Order Type', loc='upper right')

# 4. Bottom-right: Average Price by Size and Product (Heatmap)
ax4 = axes[1, 1]
size_order = ['Small', 'Medium', 'Large']
pivot_data = df.pivot_table(values='price', index='product', columns='size', aggfunc='mean')
pivot_data = pivot_data.reindex(columns=size_order)
sns.heatmap(pivot_data, annot=True, fmt='.2f', cmap='YlOrRd', ax=ax4, 
            cbar_kws={'label': 'Average Price ($)'}, linewidths=0.5)
ax4.set_xlabel('Size', fontsize=10)
ax4.set_ylabel('Product', fontsize=10)
ax4.set_title('Average Price by Product & Size', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')

# Adjust layout
plt.tight_layout()

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
